title: Weekly AI Worldview | Vtrip’s ¥100M+ A Round, Sierra $175M, Nvidia Replaces Intel in Dow
summary: One-week global AI flash: China & overseas funding, product launches, and people moves.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly Digest · November 4, 2024

One-week global AI flash: China & overseas funding, product launches, and people moves.

Funding — China

Vtrip (视旅科技): ¥100M+ Series A (Shenzhen Bao One Book Fund, Greater Bay Area Culture Industry Fund under Guangzhou Chengtou et al.) for VtripGPT travel LLM R&D and domestic/overseas destination commercialization. Founded Nov 2021; C-side AI itinerary design + dynamic package booking. Founder Li Shaohua (ex-Fliggy builder); CTO Hui Pengrui (ex-Alibaba AI senior). Early traction Sichuan / Hong Kong / Singapore; some core destinations monthly fulfillment >¥10M.

Vector Equation (向量方程): ~¥10M angel led by Zhencheng — AI digital humans. Founded Mar 2024 by ex-Dedao CTO Shen Renkui; “Pomegranate Digital Human” 1:1 video recreation; shorter shoot time vs. top video-gen vendors; Chinese-native; multi-avatar interaction. Commercial since June; expanding to interactive video.

Linke Zhihua (临科智华): ¥23M seed from Qianyi Capital — high-quality data intelligence. Founded 2024; CEO Wang Xuhui (ex-Scale AI core scientist). Train+infer appliance “Xihua Zhiqiu AW2000”; customers in AV, smart CS, manufacturing; targets ¥150M revenue next year.

Funding — Overseas

GMI Cloud (San Jose GPU cloud): $82M Series A led by Headline Asia (Banpu, Wistron strategic); total raised $93M ($15M equity + $67M debt). New Colorado DC to add N. America capacity beside Taiwan/Thailand/Malaysia; headcount to 60–70 by year-end. Differentiates with private-cloud customization + Nvidia NIM; only Taiwan CSP certified under Nvidia NCP/NPN.

Sierra (Bret Taylor — ex-Salesforce co-CEO, OpenAI board chair): $175M at $4.5B valuation (Greenoaks lead; ICONIQ, Thrive). Total raised $285M. AI CS chatbots + agents for brands (WeightWatchers, Sirius XM); reduces hallucination; brand-custom personas over OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta models.

Read AI: $50M Series B (Smash Capital lead; Madrona, Goodwater follow) — total $81M, valuation $450M. Chrome “Read AI for Gmail” unifies Slack/Teams/Zoom context into Gmail; Inbox AI summaries + reply drafts.

Industry moves

Zhipu Huazhang commits ¥125M to JV with Doushen Education (SZ 300010) — AI education R&D/sales; JV registered capital ¥500M (Zhipu 25% / Hainan Hezun 5% / Doushen 70%).

Insight Group (因赛, 300781) to acquire 80% of Zhizhe Brand (NEEQ PR firm; Huawei/Honor clients) via shares + cash — build AI full-chain marketing group. Zhizhe: 2022/2023/H1’24 rev ¥411M / ¥517M / ¥355M; NI ¥35M / ¥39M / ¥32M.

ModelBest (面壁) × Baidu AI Cloud: edge–cloud LLM solutions (MiniCPM 3.0 + Qianfan/ERNIE) for embodied AI, terminals, edge.

Tencent ima.copilot (Oct 23): Hunyuan-powered smart workbench — collect, interpret, Q&A, write; personal knowledge base; Mac first, Windows coming.

Quark upgrades AI exam-search: multi-device hard/new problems, step solutions, heuristic follow-ups.

OpenAI ChatGPT Search — timely answers + photos (sports, news, stocks) with sources; Plus/Team first → enterprise/edu → free; Chrome default-search extension; shopping/travel + o1 deeper research planned. Publisher feedback on snippet length/citation.

Google AI Overviews expanding to 100+ countries (>1B users); EN/Hindi/Indonesian/JP/PT/ES; inline links for traffic; ads in Overviews coming.

Nvidia replaces Intel in Dow Jones Industrial Average (effective Nov 8); Sherwin-Williams replaces Dow Inc. Nvidia ~$3.32T mkt cap, YTD +173%; Intel ~$99B, YTD −54% — worst Dow name. Goldman: “most important stock on Earth.”

People

Yao Shunyu (Tsinghua Physics special prize; Stanford PhD; Berkeley postdoc) joins Anthropic Claude team.

Gao Jun named SenseTime APAC Chief AI Strategy Officer (ex-Henkel digital CTO; ZF, Schindler, Schaeffler, Bosch Rexroth APAC IT).

Gabor Cselle (Pebble co-founder; ex-Twitter product; reMail→Google, Namo→Twitter) joins OpenAI on a secret project — same week Anthropic hired Embark founder Alex Rodrigues for AI safety research.

— END —
